descriptions.text: Stayfast Ink, 825 ml. Enough ink for several chonky books. Warning: this shit stains, so be careful. Nothing will ever make it fade. Nothing. Not even distance or time or the death of a star.

recap.text: Milk tells Carl that dozens of magic systems exist in ink, calligraphy and maps alone, and that the brightest inks and letters burn out fastest. She switched inks in her recipe book to share it more widely, and only now learns that everything she wrote after the change has faded. She hands him a wineskin of Stayfast Ink, 825 ml, and an adept's fountain pen.

beats.headline: Ink that does not fade
beats.text: After Donut's dog tattoo, Milk tells Carl there are more magic systems than he can imagine, dozens with ink and calligraphy and maps alone, and that inks and letters that shine the brightest burn out the fastest. She had a book once and wrote her recipes in it, then switched to a different ink to share them more widely, and only recently learned that all she wrote after the change faded and disappeared. She hands him a wineskin: Stayfast Ink, 825 ml. Then a fountain pen, the adept's, the most basic of a calligrapher's implements. He has another book, she adds, the Book of Voodoo, and anything he writes in it reaches everyone who has it.
beats.gist: Milk gives Carl Stayfast Ink and an adept's fountain pen, since her old ink faded.

relations.note: Carl takes Milk's story of her book to be about the Cookbook
